title: REUNION
tagline: less time for words, more space for laughter

dramatic.two_seconds_before: less time for words, more space for laughter. Before frame 1 we are already inside 'HUGS WITH NO REASON': the city was moving before the camera arrived, so the opening beat is a stimulus already in progress, not a cold start.

beats.verb: the body/camera loads against the coming move — the figure against cloud, floor, water
beats.line: Decades later, there is less time for words, and more space for laughter — hugs with no reason, and loud voices, so our hearts can be overheard.

beats.verb: the move reaches its extreme — the figure against cloud, floor, water
beats.line: Decades later, there is less time for words, and more space for laughter — hugs with no reason, and loud voices, so our hearts can be overheard.

beats.verb: the move lands and overshoots — the figure against street lamp, tree, cloud
beats.line: Reflecting on legacies, and creeds once told — of elders, now past.

beats.verb: the world settles into the aftermath — the figure against building, stairs, cloud
beats.line: Before our winds part ways — to a next lifetime. This is brotherhood.

flip_test.note: keys must differ enough to tell the story with no in-betweens
